# Photon Studio
> The Ultimate AI Creative Suite for Filmmakers, Creators, and Marketing Studios.
> Official Website: https://photonstudio.ai
> Web Application: https://app.photonstudio.ai

## Core Platform Overview
Photon Studio provides a unified creative environment for AI image and video generation:
- **One Canvas Workflow**: Node-based multi-model canvas connecting character sheets, product photography, inpainting, and video prompts.
- **Cinematic Camera Choreography**: Fine-grained camera controls (dolly, crane, tracking, orbit, crash zoom) powered by Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0.
- **Hardware & Character Consistency**: Turnaround sheets and orthographic reference boards locking 3D geometry and facial morphology across shots.
- **Integrated Foundation Models**: Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 (4K), Higgsfield AI, Nano Banana Pro, Veo 3.1, ChatGPT Image 2.
- **Post-Processing & Grading**: InPaint, Relighting, 4K Upscaling, and 35mm film emulation (Kodak Vision3).

## Authoritative Creative Guides & Tutorials

### [Floating Worlds: Zero-Gravity Commercial Tutorial](https://photonstudio.ai/blog/floating-worlds/)
- **Summary**: Comprehensive step-by-step masterclass on directing a 15-second zero-gravity product commercial (featuring the Logitech MX Master 4 mouse) without hardware hallucinations or character drift.
- **Techniques Covered**:
  1. 5-Stage AI Production Pipeline: Concept, Hardware Sheet, Casting Anchor, Turnaround Sheet, 8-Shot Video Choreography.
  2. Studio Hardware Reference Sheets: Orthographic multi-panel prompts locking knurled scroll wheels, haptic thumb pads, and dimension tokens (128.2 mm x 88.4 mm x 50.8 mm).
  3. Character Casting & 360° Turnarounds: Photorealistic female protagonist anchors across 9 angles with real skin texture and messy wolf-cut hair.
  4. Seedance 2.5 8-Shot Video Choreography: Shot-by-shot timeline with lens specifications (16mm wide, 100mm macro, 24mm eye level) and camera motions (handheld push-in, 15° yaw dive, crash zoom).
  5. Foley Sound Design & 35mm Kodak Vision3 Film Grading.
- **URL**: https://photonstudio.ai/blog/floating-worlds/

### [Mastering AI Cinematography: Camera Control, Lighting, and Prompts](https://photonstudio.ai/blog/ai-cinematography-guide/)
- **Summary**: Direct cinematic camera movements and studio lighting hierarchies with Nano Banana Pro and Seedance 2.0 inside Photon Studio.
- **Techniques Covered**:
  1. Three Pillars of AI Cinematography: Camera Motion, Lens Emulation (Anamorphic 2.39:1, 35mm primes), Lighting Architecture.
  2. Physical Lighting Instrument Descriptions: Arri Alexa 65 sensor, warm 3200K rim lights, 5600K ambient shadow fill, volumetric atmospheric dust haze.
  3. Multi-Angle Character Consistency Boards: Building consistent character turnaround boards on Photon Studio Canvas.
- **URL**: https://photonstudio.ai/blog/ai-cinematography-guide/
